Listen to a native clip and speak along with it half a beat behind, copying rhythm and melody, not just words.
My routine since September 2024: one 40 second clip, 10 rounds. Rounds 1 to 3 just listen with the transcript,
4 to 7 mumble along, 8 to 10 full voice while walking along the Tejo at lunch (people stare, whatever). Sources: Ito
Shingo's "Japanese shadowing" CD tracks 12 to 30, Mandarin Corner podcast episodes under 3 minutes, and for German the
Easy German street interviews at 0.75x. Record round 10 and compare in Audacity side by side. It fixed my Mandarin
third tones faster than any drill ([[Mandarin tones]]) and is the backbone of [[Accent reduction]].
